queries: Read the known identity realm OIDC discovery configuration; inspect device_authorization_endpoint.
POST standard device authorization using only the known web client_id and openid/profile scope; no secret or password.

source_checks.claim: The normal device-authorization attempt for the known web client returns401unauthorized_client with Invalid client or Invalid client credentials.
source_checks.comparison: Realm discovery advertises the grant, but this client cannot initiate it with the available public client identifier. No authorized platform session, task ID or image selection resulted.

summary: Checked the publicly advertised OIDC device authorization flow as an alternative to browser control. The known web client returned401unauthorized_client: Invalid client or Invalid client credentials. This normal authentication attempt did not obtain a session or permit submission. Do not request user passwords or infer a usable API from discovery alone. Browser control or user-side platform submission is still required.
